verdict.rationale: Bevy documents an in-depth API reference with inline examples and a separate gallery of examples that run in the browser via WASM with viewable source. The runnable examples are not part of the API reference, which a probe describes as fully static. missing for 10: an interactive API reference in which the examples themselves can be run or edited, a unified reference-plus-runnable experience, and independent hands-on corroboration of the reference's interactivity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: Learn how to use Bevy's types, traits and methods using the in-depth reference documentation, complete with inline examples.
Click an example below to run it in your browser (using WASM + WebGL) and view the source code.
Browse bevy examples compiled to wasm and running directly in your browser!
docs.rs/bevy gives fully static, crawlable API docs
